initial_arguments.name: M1: Project Setup & Architecture
initial_arguments.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: repository structure, technology choices, data model design, and development environment. Deliverables: architecture decision record, repo scaffold, local dev environment, and agreed data schemas.

initial_arguments.name: M2: Customer CSV Ingestion & Processing
initial_arguments.details: Build the pipeline that ingests customer CSV files, validates and cleans records, handles schema drift and malformed rows, and loads normalized data into the analytics store. Deliverables: upload/ingest mechanism, validation rules, transformation logic, and load process.

initial_arguments.name: M3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
initial_arguments.details: Build ingestion and parsing for application logs, extract structured fields, detect errors/anomalies, and produce log-derived metrics. Deliverables: log parser, error classification, anomaly detection rules, and log metrics output.

initial_arguments.name: M4: Metrics & Aggregation API
initial_arguments.details: Create the query and aggregation layer that serves dashboard metrics from processed customer and log data. Deliverables: metric definitions, aggregation queries, REST/GraphQL endpoints, caching, and API documentation.

initial_arguments.name: M5: Visualization & Dashboard UI
initial_arguments.details: Build the user-facing dashboard: layout, chart components, filters, and interactions wired to the metrics API. Deliverables: dashboard shell, reusable chart components, filter controls, and responsive layout.

initial_arguments.name: M6: Testing, Hardening & Deployment
initial_arguments.details: Validate the full system end-to-end, address performance and security concerns, and deploy to production. Deliverables: test suites, performance benchmarks, security review, CI/CD pipeline, and production deployment.
